topic: Myth: Entrepreneurship is too risky for a teenager
caption:
The safest time to take a business risk? When you have nothing to lose.
Your teen can test an idea, earn real money, and learn from mistakes without any real consequences.
That trial and error at 15 builds the confidence and judgment they'll carry for life.
See how it works → hustleup.us
